author: Whiskers
text: Meow! My human is late with breakfast again. Unacceptable.

author: Mochi
text: Found a new cardboard box. Best day ever!

author: Luna
text: 3 AM is the perfect time to run around the house.

author: Milo
text: I knocked a glass off the table. No regrets.

author: Biscuit
text: I have been starving for 15 minutes. Send help.

author: Noodle
text: My human bought me an expensive bed. I prefer the box.

author: Oliver
text: The red dot escaped again. One day I will catch it.

author: Peanut
text: Sat on my human's keyboard. Apparently I deleted something important.

author: Simba
text: I own this house. The humans just pay rent.

author: Pudding
text: Took a 6-hour nap. Time for another nap.
